principle: The fixed shell owns presentation and interaction. The paper manifest must contain reader-ready scientific content, not parser diagnostics or raw PDF fragments.

modules.reader_question: What paper am I reading and why is it relevant?
requirements: title_zh is a fluent scientific Chinese translation rather than copied English
authors and affiliations are extracted as actual names and institutions
publication_timeline includes available received, revised, accepted, online and issue dates
citation contains volume, issue or article number, page range and PDF pages when available
journal_scope explains the journal in one factual sentence
field_positioning explains the paper's disciplinary position in one reader-facing sentence
forbidden: Authors listed in the source PDF

modules.reader_question: Can I understand the entire study before reading the body?
fixed_questions: 模型或分析的输入与输出是什么？
主要生物学发现是什么？
requirements: each answer is a specific synthesis of this paper, normally 35-140 Chinese characters
core data names cohorts, sample sizes, modalities and paired or validation relationships
input-output states the analytical object, transformation and final output, not a copied Methods paragraph
biological finding and clinical result are distinct and include concrete findings
limitations state limitations reported or directly supported by the study design
method is a concise arrow-linked workflow of 5-9 stages
story is a one-paragraph conclusion explaining what the study establishes and what it does not

modules.reader_question: Does the body follow the scientific argument rather than the PDF layout?
requirements: retain genuine article section and subsection boundaries in source order
every English heading has an accurate Chinese heading
front-page title fragments, highlights bullets, author lines, running headers and figure labels are not sections
duplicate References headings are collapsed to one reference area
methods subsections remain available but do not replace the paper's results narrative

modules.reader_question: Can I read the original and translation paragraph by paragraph without losing context?
requirements: one source paragraph is one bilingual unit unless a publisher physically splits it across columns or pages
English is source-faithful and preserves citations and figure references
Chinese is a complete contextual translation with terminology kept consistent across the paper
sentences are not cut mid-sentence and unrelated paragraphs are not merged
terms are highlighted only after the translation is stable

modules.reader_question: Can I tell what a figure proves before opening it?
requirements: title includes the figure number and complete descriptive title
intro is a 1-2 sentence reader-facing description of the figure's role in the paper
image contains the complete source figure at readable resolution
caption_en is the complete source legend without body-paragraph contamination
caption_zh is a full Chinese translation
study.overview explains how to read the whole figure and its relation to adjacent figures
study.panels contains every labeled panel or logical block with a specific title and explanation
panel explanations describe axes, objects, comparisons, results and connections without inventing evidence
study.conclusion states the figure-level conclusion and the next logical step

modules.reader_question: Can I inspect a table as structured data rather than as an unreadable screenshot?
requirements: source tables are emitted with kind=table
headers and rows preserve the source structure
title and caption are bilingual
an image fallback is allowed only when merged cells cannot be reconstructed, and must be explicitly audited

modules.reader_question: Can an unfamiliar reader understand the paper's recurring terminology?
requirements: include recurring domain, method and statistical terms that materially affect interpretation
definitions explain the term in the context of this paper
aliases cover source spelling and common abbreviations
do not highlight ordinary words or entire acronym expansions

modules.reader_question: Can I trace every citation to the correct source?
requirements: preserve original reference numbering
retain complete bibliographic text
citation ranges map to all included references
reference count and missing numbers are audited against the source

release_rule: A raw PDF extraction may be stored for evidence, but it must not be rendered as a candidate reader until all reader-facing modules pass the content-quality validator.
